title: Threads
purpose: Registered production background and extracted alpha foreground; enlarged usable opening

REFERENCE 2: existing icon, preserve its recognisable identity/colors but no icon pedestal needed. REFERENCE 3: Village calendar background, match its polished storybook sculpted 3D village aesthetic and usable front-facing surface, NOT photographic realism.

LEFT: A cream conversational notebook board in black linen and oak. integrated physically into setting. Large front-facing nearly rectangular blank usable area x5–65%, y14–81%, subtle light ivory material, unobstructed and no printed UI. Frame mounted plausibly on wall/desk/easel; correct contact shadows. No forced perspective across usable surface.
RIGHT x69–100%: create a rich lived-in functional vignette, as engaging and detailed as reference1. Furnishings, task-related instruments, layered shelves, plants, small textiles, foreground and background depth; objects tell what this app does. Recognizable brand mark on a real useful object plus a modest "Threads" label; NOT an enormous billboard, giant floating logo, or generic sign. Use varied functions/materials and actual setting, not another bridge/mountains scene. Keep only a small companion landing patch near lower right, not a whole empty half.
Warm daylight, cream stone, tactile timber/brass/ceramic, coherent lighting, soft stylized shapes, saturated but tasteful greenery. Rich exterior or interior as setting dictates. Blank LEFT content surface must dominate usable area while RIGHT remains visually rich. No people, no companion character, no UI overlay, no watermarks. No dynamic sample content yet.

Put the bottom frame at98% canvas height, nearly touching the bottom image edge. Replace ALL floor, rugs, counters, legs and foreground objects UNDER THE LEFT BOARD with blank paper down to96%. Keep thin original-colored physical border outside. Remain front-facing rectangular so a real website or HTML can occupy most of its height. VERY IMPORTANT do not leave a large strip of floor below the board. Bottom frame nearly touches bottom image edge. This is roughly80% USABLE HEIGHT once the host toolbar and inner safety margin are allowed for. Do NOT widen it to80% width. Keep the exact original left and right board edges and right scene width. refinements: Expand usable surface to approximately 70% width and 80% height, retain characteristic brand scene; remove baked-in companions.

Edit this village applet scene, preserving its exact artistic style, brand identity, frame material and all right-side functional scenery.
